purpose: Micro-motion only. Fail if face/body/style drift while barely moving.

defaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, morphing face, identity change, style change, different person, warped anatomy, large motion, camera pan

lock_preamble: IDENTITY AND STYLE LOCK FROM THE INPUT IMAGE. Exact same person and visual style. Only tiny natural micro-motion. No redesign.
